Positive initial S,I,R and S+I+R<=K stay in the invariant simplex; x_n=K-S_n>=I_n, I_n is positive strictly decreasing, and a uniform lower bound on tau_n proves extinction I_n->0. Stable forced recurrences give x_n,R_n->0. The ratio r_n=x_n/I_n satisfies a contractive affine recursion with limiting fixed point k/mu; reciprocal increments 1/I_{n+1}-1/I_n->beta k h/[mu(1+kh)]. Cesaro proves lim nhI_n=mu(1+kh)/(beta k). The ODE similarly has r(t)->k/mu and lim t I(t)=mu/(beta k). Independently checked exact rational step identities and an 800000-step trajectory, not as an infinite proof.
